claim: The API Gateway pricing page lists a free tier of one million API calls received for REST APIs, one million API calls received for HTTP APIs, and one million messages and 750,000 connection minutes for WebSocket APIs per month for up to 12 months, only for new AWS customers within 12 months of their sign-up date; the same page says that starting July 15, 2025, new AWS customers receive up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits.
question: What free tier does the API Gateway pricing page list, for whom, and what does the same page say about new customers from July 15, 2025?

qualifiers.scope: per month, per eligible account, as listed on the API Gateway pricing page
qualifiers.condition: Only for new AWS customers, for 12 months after sign-up; the same page also states the Free Tier credits offer for new customers starting July 15, 2025.

evidence.quote: The Amazon API Gateway free tier includes one million API calls received for REST APIs, one million API calls received for HTTP APIs, and one million messages and 750,000 connection minutes for WebSocket APIs per month for up to 12 months.
These free tier offers are only available to new AWS customers, and are available for 12 months following your AWS sign-up date.
Starting July 15, 2025, new AWS customers will receive up to $200 in AWS Free Tier credits, which can be applied towards eligible AWS services, including Amazon API Gateway.
